risks.risk: Brakes may not actually stop strongly/safely (pads worn, cable stretched, misadjusted).
risks.proof: Short video of a safe stop test (ride slowly, squeeze both brakes; show quick stop) plus close-up of brake pads/cables.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as brakes not confirmed (assume needs adjustment/service).

risks.risk: Gears may skip or not shift cleanly under load (chain wear, derailleur misalignment).
risks.proof: Video shifting through all gears while pedaling, showing chain staying on sprockets (no skipping).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as gears not confirmed (assume may need adjustment/repair).

risks.risk: Rust/corrosion may exist in hidden areas (underside frame, chain area, crank).
risks.proof: Close-ups of chain, crank area, underside of frame, and any weld/joint points.

risks.risk: Wheel size/fit may be wrong for the child, affecting resale value.
risks.proof: Photo of wheel size marking or measured wheel diameter.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the lowest likely kids-bike value without confirmed size.

risks.risk: Non-original/replaced parts may be present (brakes, seat, grips, pedals), reducing value.
risks.proof: Close-ups of key components showing markings/condition (brake levers, shifters/derailleur, chain, seat clamp, pedals).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as parts may not be fully original.

proof_requests: Brake close-ups (both sides) showing pads/cables and any wear.
Gear/shifter close-ups (derailleur/chain area) and a short shifting video through all gears.
A short brake stop test video (quick, straight stop).
Close-ups of chain/crank and underside frame for rust/corrosion.
Wheel size confirmation (marking photo or wheel diameter measurement).
response.reason: The seller’s claim of testing is not verifiable without the specific visual proof (brake/gear close-ups and test videos). With only the single wide photo, the key factors that determine price can’t be confirmed, so we should request proof before pricing.
